document.about: US Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management, awarded major procurements (Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365), shrunk to fit its pages: 6 point type, and each office's contracts under a dark band holding its name in 5.5 point type between rules 7.5 points apart.

checks.issue: On page 2 the band `Idaho (ID)` was no row of its own: its rules stand closer than a cell's height, and the band ran into the row under it (`Idaho (ID) Advanced Mixed Waste Treatment Project`). Its contracts carried the band before it, `Hanford Procurement Office …`.
As above, the band `Oak Ridge Office OF Environmental Management (OREM)`, its name split between the first two cells of the row under it.
